newsitem.title: USA: American Builders & Contractors Supply issues debt.
newsitem.headline: American Builders & Contractors Supply issues debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from American Builders & Contractors Supply Co was priced on Friday, according to a high-yield market source.
The company, which distributes roofing and siding materials, will use proceeds from the issue largely to refinance outstanding bank debt, the source said.
NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc was lead manager.
